name: eUSD
oneLiner: eUSD is Telcoin Digital Asset Bank's dollar stablecoin, issued under a Nebraska digital-asset depository charter with KYC-gated 1:1 mint and redemption.
collateral: Cash and high-quality liquid dollar reserves managed by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank for the eUSD issued token
pegMechanism: Bank-issued dollar token with KYC-gated mint and redemption through Telcoin banking rails

jurisdiction.regulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance

mintAuthority.summary: eUSD is issued by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository charter; the bank mints eUSD against USD deposits and Treasuries and burns on redemption through KYC-gated banking rails.

controls.label: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank issuance backend
controls.evidence: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank minted the initial eUSD supply directly on Ethereum and Polygon and lets account holders mint/redeem against USD deposits and short-term Treasuries; supply is bank-controlled with no permissionless mint route.

review.evidence: Telcoin announcements describe the chartered bank minting eUSD as a bank-issued dollar stablecoin backed 1:1 by USD deposits and Treasuries with KYC-gated mint/redeem; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the bank-issuer model in Telcoin materials; the on-chain owner/minter admin for the shared eUSD contract address across chains was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/minter admin for the eUSD contract (Ethereum/Base/Polygon) and the Solana mint authority before raising confidence.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

reserves.name: Cash and high-quality dollar reserve assets
